title: Warm strawberry and orange compote with yoghurt

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Strawberries, orange, honey, vanilla, nuts, seeds and Greek yoghurt are all plain kitchen staples with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every item is a standard Tesco line at an ordinary price, with nothing specialist.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a small pan, a frying pan and a knife, and simmering fruit and dry-toasting nuts suit a beginner.

works.reason: 500g strawberries over 500g yoghurt with 110g nuts and seeds makes a sensible breakfast for four, and the 5-minute simmer with orange juice gives a jammy compote without burning.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes covers hulling 500g strawberries, zesting and juicing an orange and chopping almonds, and the 5 plus 3 minutes of cooking match the 8 printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the cinnamon and mint, appears in the steps, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Early-season strawberries are the main body of the dish, and a warm compote suits a cool May morning.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and read like everyday British home cooking.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fruit, protein-rich yoghurt, nuts and seeds with only a tablespoon of honey make a filling breakfast a family would happily repeat.
